[[US Tshinkunku]] (cup winner) | continentalcup3 = | continentalcup3 qualifiers = | league topscorer = | matches = | prevseason = [[2010 Linafoot|2010]] | nextseason = [[2012 Linafoot|2012]] }} The '''2011 Linafoot season''' was the 50th season of Top League [[Linafoot]] in [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|DR Congo]]. Defending champions are [[AS Vita Club|AS Vita]] from [[Kinshasa]]. Seventeen teams entered the competition. [[TP Mazembe]] won the championship.{{cite web|title=TP Mazembe wins championship|url=http://radiookapi.net/sport/2011/10/16/vodacom-super-ligue-tp-mazembe-sacre-champion-de-la-linafoot/|publisher=radiookapi.net|accessdate=19 October 2011|language=French|date=16 October 2011}} ==Changes from 2010== A new format was introduced. In contrast to the previous season, the final round is made up of eight teams in one group. In 2010 eight teams were divided into two groups of four with the top two finishers advancing to yet another group stage. The winner of the group of 8 will be the champion.{{cite web|title=New system explained|url=http://www.lepotentiel.cd/2011/03/la-phase-classique-de-lavodacom-super-league-demarre-le-9-avril.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120402132230/http://www.lepotentiel.cd/2011/03/la-phase-classique-de-lavodacom-super-league-demarre-le-9-avril.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=2 April 2012|publisher=lepotentiel.cd|accessdate=17 September 2011|language=French|date=31 March 2011}} [https://web.archive.org/web/20120402132230/http://www.lepotentiel.cd/2011/03/la-phase-classique-de-lavodacom-super-league-demarre-le-9-avril.html new format 2011 year] ==Preliminary round== In the preliminary round 12 teams in three groups played a double round robin.
